question.worked_solution:
Notice that the terms of the corresponding sequence

$$
11,\,22,\,33,\,…,\,242,\,253.
$$

are multiples of $11.$ Since $253÷11=23,$ there are $23$ terms in total. 

Therefore, the $n$th term of the sequence has the form

$$
{a}_{n}=11n,
$$

where $n$ ranges from $n=1$ to $n=23.$ Indeed:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{1} & =11(1)=11 \\ {a}_{2} & =11(2)=22 \\ {a}_{3} & =11(3)=33 \\  & \,\,⋮ \\ {a}_{22} & =11(22)=242 \\ {a}_{23} & =11(23)=253\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
S=11+22+33+⋯+242+253={\sum }_{n=1}^{23}11n.
$$
